content:
{
  "root_cause": "Missing blur event listener on the date input field causes the datepicker to remain open when the user tabs away after typing an unavailable date.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add a blur listener to the input that calls datepicker.hide() to close the calendar when focus leaves the field, but only for non-inline datepickers (since the listener is only registered for dropdown mode).",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "js/Datepicker.js",
      "sha256": "55bc634a806da095ca30921bdc0d463fdc2fd63dff3eeab32b3d673bab3ef609",
      "before": "      const onMousedownDocument = onClickOutside.bind(null, this);
      const listeners = [
        [inputField, 'keydown', onKeydown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'focus', onFocus.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'mousedown', onMousedown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'click', onClickInput.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'paste', onPaste.bind(null, this)],
        [document, 'mousedown', onMousedownDocument],
        [document, 'touchstart', onMousedownDocument],
        [window, 'resize', picker.place.bind(picker)]
      ];
      registerListeners(this, listeners);",
      "after": "      const onMousedownDocument = onClickOutside.bind(null, this);
      const listeners = [
        [inputField, 'keydown', onKeydown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'focus', onFocus.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'blur', () => picker.hide()],
        [inputField, 'mousedown', onMousedown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'click', onClickInput.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'paste', onPaste.bind(null, this)],
        [document, 'mousedown', onMousedownDocument],
        [document, 'touchstart', onMousedownDocument],
        [window, 'resize', picker.place.bind(picker)]
      ];
      registerListeners(this, listeners);"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Keyboard users can tab out of the date field and the datepicker will close, ensuring that the calendar does not obstruct subsequent fields and focus order is respected.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Hiding the picker on blur may interfere with scenarios where the picker is programmatically shown and the input loses focus temporarily.",
    "If the picker relies on blur for validation, unintended hiding could occur."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Tabbing away from the date field after typing a valid or invalid date closes the datepicker.",
    "Selecting a date via mouse or keyboard within the picker still updates the input and hides the picker as appropriate.",
    "Inline datepickers remain unaffected.",
    "Blur does not cause premature hiding when the picker is opened via script."
  ]
}
